experiment_data.hypothesis: Cutoff at 25K steps (vs 35K in standard cutoff) tests the minimum duration of auxiliary gradient flow needed for collision avoidance. If CAR degrades vs cutoff@35K, the encoder needs sustained gradient flow beyond 25K steps to maintain safety-relevant features.
